blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these steps use the addition property of equality? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Which of these steps use the addition property of equality? Select all that apply.

blocks.text: X minus four equals nine becomes x equals thirteen. Four is added to both sides, so this is the addition property.
X plus four equals nine becomes x equals five. Four is subtracted from both sides, so this is the subtraction property, not addition.
X minus seven equals two becomes x equals nine. Seven is added to both sides: the addition property.
Three x equals twelve becomes x equals four. Both sides are divided by three, so this is the division property.
X minus one equals six becomes x equals seven. One is added to both sides: the addition property.
Three steps use the addition property. Each one adds the same number to both sides to undo a subtraction.
